numeric_pinyin_notes: Tones 1–4 as digits; neutral tone = 5; ü written as v (e.g. nv3, lv3you2).
numeric_citation = dictionary tones (一 as yi1, 不 as bu4).
numeric_sandhi = spoken tones within the word: 3+3 -> 2+3; 一 -> yi2 before tone 4, yi4 before tones 1-3; 不 -> bu2 before tone 4.
Erhua (哪儿, 一点儿) is merged into the preceding syllable (na3r, yi4dian3r).
Frame constructions (虽然……但是……) separate parts with '...'.
